announcements.body: @Announcements Proud to announce the first beta of the launcher is released! See #channel to get all the feature information on what it can and cannot do. If you have any questions feel free to ask me, or ping me if there are any issues. I hope you guys love it, its a lot nicer than the first sneak peek i showed

announcements.author: xSHXDEx
announcements.body: @Announcements Some of you may know, but some behind the scenes stuff is going on to revamp the madness crew experience with the games, and midtown madness is also being reworked. I have started a launcher for all of the games, it manages your games, has command line options, AR file management and folder detection, a chat room, individual usernames, and will let you play the games directly from the launcher. This is to make quality of life easier for booting up your favorite madness game, and seeing who is online/using the launcher. Still WIP and there will be an announcement when it is finished and released. Here's a teaser #makemidtownmadnessgreatagain

Hello, @Announcements 
@xSHXDEx has setup a [Radmin VPN](https://www.radmin-vpn.com/) network for all Madness Crew members to join with a password of "madness98" and a network name of "madnesscrew"
This will be required for online play for games in the Monster Truck Madness series and the Motocross Madness series and may also prove useful for both mm1 and mm2!

announcements.author: 𝐏𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐳
announcements.body:
**THIS IS DIRECTED TOWARDS ALL MEMBERS OF MADNESS CREW**

Alright, I can't believe I have to say this, but it has come to my attention that some members have been getting disrespected for no reason at all. Please if you guys have nothing nice to say keep your fingers off the keyboard and move on with your day. If you don't like someone's mod, please give constructive feedback so the modder can work on stuff instead of making them feel like their work is awful. 

Most of us here have crude humor and like to make jokes/poke fun at each other but the random attacking people with name-calling needs to stop if the person doesn’t like it. 

Thank you for your attention to this matter and have a good rest of your weekend! ❤️

@Announcements
